newsitem.title: CHINA: China to purchase 2.75 mln T of tobacco leaf in 97.
newsitem.headline: China to purchase 2.75 mln T of tobacco leaf in 97.

text.p: China's state purchases of tobacco are expected to reach 2.75 million tonnes this year, an official of the State Tobacco Monopoly Administration said on Friday.
Total funds for purchasing tobacco would exceed 36 billion yuan, the official said.
The funds would be provided through loans from the Agricultural Bank of China, he said.
China's tobacco planting area reached 1.658 million hectares in 1997, up by 186,600 hectares from last year, and 353,000 hectares more than set by the state plan, he said.

"We will not only purchase the planned amount of tobacco leaf, but also buy the amount above the plan, so that farmers' profits can be protected, and social stability can be maintained in tobacco producing areas," he said.
China's cigarette output has been estimated at 34.25 million cartons this year, unchanged from last year.
